VI.description: Drives LMock's own Mock Class Generator headlessly. Takes the interface path and the destination mock class path as strings, and returns the list of files LMock created.

FreeLabel.comment: Paths arrive as strings because a VI Server control value cannot coerce a string into a path.

Control.description: Absolute path of the INTERFACE to mock. Must be a .lvclass whose NI.LVClass.IsInterface is true - an ordinary class is refused with Error 1704 and a modal dialog.
Absolute path of the mock .lvclass to create.

Call.target: LMock Mock Class Generator.lvclass\3ALMock Generate Mock Class.vi
Call.inputs: Source Class Path:5040.path,Destination Class Path:5050.path,Add to lvproj?:5035.value,error in (no error):5030.value
